introduction.question: What brings you to MindrianOS?

no client marker, query parameter or introduction skip can grant authentication
login rejection, cancellation and expired session remain gated
successful Google login preserves the internal return destination
introduction completion and skip preserve the same requested resource
empty or invalid optional introduction never blocks authenticated skip
unavailable intro storage and submission failure do not bypass Google authentication
sign-out clears stale intro progress and revokes access for later protected requests
marketing permission is separate, explicit and unchecked
no tokens, contact data or answer values in analytics, replay, URLs or application logs

readStrategy: Walk each selected segment as a room: identity (ROOM.md) for its one job, routing (INDEX.md) to reach a smaller segment or an artifact, contract (CONTEXT.md) for inputs, process, outputs and the human check, state (STATE.md) for status and artifact count, then only the artifacts the current job needs. Read inherited rules and contracts first; never load every descendant. The segment process is the procedure for that part of the work and its human check is the acceptance test.
